narrative.overview: Boundary studies presents each vulnerability disclosure as a study in an exhibition. Selecting a product changes the sculpture and the adjacent case description. The case links lead to the full finding, attribution and primary sources.
keyCharacteristics: A dark stage holds the title and sculpture above a paper strip of selectable studies.
Warm paper carries long-form work. Ruled rows align years, titles and advisory identifiers across the research archive.
The latest contest result includes the award, both researchers’ credit and the team placements.
dos: Keep attribution, identifiers and source links legible when research rows reflow.
Pair vermilion with dark ink. Use burnt orange for small colored text on paper.
Keep screen navigation and controls outside the printed résumé.
